II. इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य महारत निर्धारित करना और ग्रेड असाइन करना है।
III. इसका उपयोग अक्सर छात्र उपलब्धियों को प्रमाणित करने के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding
Summative Evaluation:
I. It is conducted at the conclusion of an
instructional period.
II. Its main purpose is to determine mastery
and assign grades.
III. It is frequently used for certifying student
achievement.
Which of the statements given above is/are
correct?
options_english: I, II and III
I and II only
II and III only

questions.explanation_english:
Summative evaluation takes place at the
completion of an instructional unit, course,
or academic year. Its principal objective is to
determine final mastery, award grades, and
certify overall achievement against established
curriculum standards. By evaluating cumulative
outcomes, summative assessment provides
formal administrative data used for promotional
advancement, institutional accountability, and
official student academic certification.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। समापन मूल्यांकन एक शैक्षणिक इकाई, पाठ्यक्रम, या शैक्षणिक वर्ष के समापन पर होता है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य अंतिम महारत निर्धारित करना, ग्रेड असाइन करना और स्थापित पाठ्यक्रम मानकों के खिलाफ समग्र उपलब्धियों को प्रमाणित करना है। संचयी परिणामों का मूल्यांकन करके, समापन मूल्यांकन औपचारिक प्रशासनिक डेटा प्रदान करता है जिसका उपयोग पदोन्नति, संस्थागत जवाबदेही, और आधिकारिक छात्र शैक्षणिक प्रमाणन के लिए किया जाता है।
key_facts: Summative evaluation is conducted at the end of an instructional period.
It aims to determine mastery and assign grades.
Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

questions.question_english: In the context of educational management, how is evaluation distinct from measurement?
options_english: Measurement assigns numerals to traits, whereas evaluation adds value judgment to measurement
Measurement is qualitative, whereas evaluation is strictly quantitative
Measurement is broad and continuous, whereas evaluation is narrow and discrete
Measurement includes policy formation, whereas evaluation restricts itself to testing
questions.explanation_english: Measurement represents the process of quantifying physical or psychological attributes by assigning numerical values according to specific rules. Evaluation extends beyond quantitative measurement by synthesizing qualitative observation and empirical data to render value judgments regarding educational progress. This distinction ensures that educational evaluation incorporates qualitative standards alongside raw numeric performance metrics.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मापन भौतिक या मनोवैज्ञानिक गुणों को संख्यात्मक मान सौंपकर मात्रात्मक प्रक्रिया का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। मूल्यांकन मात्रात्मक मापन से परे जाता है, गुणात्मक अवलोकन और अनुभवजन्य डेटा को एकीकृत करके शैक्षिक प्रगति के संबंध में मूल्यांकन निर्णय करता है। यह भिन्नता सुनिश्चित करती है कि शैक्षिक मूल्यांकन कच्चे संख्यात्मक प्रदर्शन मेट्रिक्स के साथ-साथ गुणात्मक मानकों को शामिल करता है।
key_facts: मापन गुणों को संख्याओं में परिवर्तित करता है, जबकि मूल्यांकन मापन में मूल्यांकन जोड़ता है
Printed answer key: (a) Measurement assigns numerals to traits, whereas evaluation adds value judgment to measurement

questions.question_english: The concept of Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE) in India drew its philosophical and policy roots primarily from the recommendations of:
options_english: The Hunter Commission (1882)
The Secondary Education Commission (1952)
The National Policy on Education (1986)
The Wood's Despatch (1854)
questions.explanation_english: The National Policy on Education (NPE) 1986 strongly recommended the implementation of Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation that incorporates both scholastic and non-scholastic aspects of learning. NPE 1986 sought to eliminate the stress associated with high-stakes terminal examinations by advocating regular assessment embedded in the instructional process, laying the policy groundwork for later statutory CCE mandates.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NPE) 1986 ने निरंतर और समग्र मूल्यांकन के कार्यान्वयन की सिफारिश की, जो शैक्षणिक और गैर-शैक्षणिक दोनों पहलुओं को शामिल करता है। NPE 1986 ने उच्च-जोखिम टर्मिनल परीक्षाओं से जुड़े तनाव को समाप्त करने का प्रयास किया, नियमित मूल्यांकन को शैक्षणिक प्रक्रिया में समाहित करने की वकालत की, जिससे बाद में वैधानिक CCE आदेशों के लिए नीतिगत आधार तैयार हुआ।
key_facts: NPE 1986 emphasizes Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation.
It aims to reduce stress from high-stakes examinations.
Printed answer key: (C) The National Policy on Education (1986)

questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the purpose of evaluation in the school education system.

questions.explanation_english: Evaluation highlights gaps in learning, measures pedagogical effectiveness, predicts academic growth, and identifies learning difficulties. Systemic assessment ensures that educational curricula remain responsive to dynamic learning needs rather than remaining static over extended academic periods.

78. Read the given assertion and reason carefully and select the correct option.
Assertion (A): In a normal probability curve, the mean, median, and mode coincide at the center of the distribution.
Reason (R): The normal distribution is perfectly symmetrical around its center.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are false
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In a perfectly symmetrical normal probability curve, score distribution is balanced evenly on both sides of the central point. key_facts: Normal distribution is symmetrical around the mean.

questions.explanation_english: Diagnostic tests are significantly more granular and detailed than general formative checks because their purpose is to isolate specific sub-skill deficits causing persistent learning failures. questions.question_english: 89. In educational measurement, the 'halo effect' refers to an error where:
options_english: General impression influences grading of specific traits
The examiner consistently maintains an excessively strict standard when grading all students
The test questions are designed too easily, resulting in universally inflated student scores

questions.explanation_english: The halo effect is an evaluative bias where an examiner's general impression or prior perception of a student influences the grading of specific, unrelated performance traits. For example, a teacher might rate a well-behaved student's essay higher due to positive past impressions, compromising scoring objectivity and construct validity across subjective assessments.

questions.question_english: A Principal receives a complaint that teachers are only evaluating the final science project model, ignoring the research, planning, and teamwork stages. To rectify this, the Principal should instruct the teachers to implement:

questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक जटिल वैज्ञानिक परियोजना का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए अनुसंधान, योजना, सहयोग और निष्पादन के साथ-साथ अंतिम उत्पाद का मूल्यांकन करना आवश्यक है। प्रक्रिया-उन्मुख मानक को लागू करने से शिक्षकों को प्रत्येक विकासात्मक चरण का व्यवस्थित रूप से मूल्यांकन करने की अनुमति मिलती है। यह दृष्टिकोण महत्वपूर्ण सोच, पूछताछ कौशल और टीमवर्क का व्यापक मूल्यांकन सुनिश्चित करता है, जिससे मूल्यांकन केवल अंतिम भौतिक वस्तु पर केंद्रित नहीं होता है।
